summary: Master mobile data collection and analysis with our ODK training. Gain practical skills in mapping and data interpretation for impactful results.
lede: Mobile data collection with ODK supports field surveys, including offline collection and synchronization. For researchers, monitoring and evaluation specialists, and teams running public, humanitarian, environmental, or corporate field work, the course covers building forms with logic and multimedia, checking data quality, and analyzing and mapping results using GPS data.
audienceIntro: This course is perfect for professionals eager to optimize field data processes and deliver impactful insights:
audience: Humanitarian aid workers in crisis response scenarios
modules: Introduction to ODK and Mobile Data Collection
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
